ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark pixels (~90-95%) with high-intensity white localized punctate clusters (~5-10%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed high-intensity white circular blobs (5-15 pixel diameter) distributed across a dark field; concentration is highest on the distal tips and along the trailing edges of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 120 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys of 2-5 pixels) along the entire continuous trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory starting from the lateral tips and transitioning to a slight concavity as it approaches the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (rosettes) distributed across the visible surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive distribution of circular white punctate scars across the visible fluke surface.
